sources.title: Dext Pricing | Plans for Every Business

keyLimits.en: 250 documents/month, 5 users included; annual billing option available at $302.50/year (up to 20% savings versus monthly).

addOns.en: AI Assist (bookkeeping automation), from $10.50/month (promotional pricing seen through Oct 31).
Commerce Lite (connect up to 5 e-commerce platforms, auto-import transactions), from $7.50/month.
Line Item Extraction, from $20.50/month or $0.50/document pay-as-you-go.
Supplier Statement Extraction, from $20.50/month or $0.50/document pay-as-you-go.
Bank Statement Extraction, from $13.00/month or $0.32/document pay-as-you-go.
Vault digital storage: free up to 100MB, additional storage from $4/month.

cautions.en: The base plan's document allowance (250/month) is easy to exceed for active bookkeeping use; extraction features beyond basic receipt capture (line items, supplier statements, bank statements) are unbundled add-ons billed separately, either as a flat monthly fee or per document.
Custom pricing applies for businesses with high document volumes or 5+ entities, so the listed base price does not scale linearly for larger operations.

capabilities.en: Receipt and invoice capture with OCR, expense management and document storage, built for bookkeeping preparation.
Integrations with accounting software for pushing captured documents directly into the books.
Optional add-on extraction engines for bank statements, supplier statements and itemized line items, sold separately from the base plan.

limitations.en: No free plan; only a 14-day trial before the base subscription is required.
Core document-processing capacity (250 documents/month on the base plan) is capped, and advanced extraction (line items, bank/supplier statements) is not included by default.

reason.en: Full accounting platform with its own receipt-capture features, competing at the broader bookkeeping layer.
Cloud accounting software with native or integrated receipt/expense capture, an alternative to pairing Dext with a separate accounting tool.
All-in-one accounting and bookkeeping platform for SMBs, covering document capture alongside full accounting.

unknowns: Whether the $25.21/month base price is itself billed monthly or is the monthly-equivalent of the $302.50 annual price was not stated unambiguously on the pricing page; both values are recorded here as seen.
Currency shown was USD by default on the fetched page; Dext prices in multiple currencies (GBP, EUR, CAD, AUD, ZAR) by region, per third-party sources, not independently confirmed here.
